front: How does cholera toxin cause diarrhoea?
back: Intestinal cells secrete chloride ions into the lumen; water potential falls; water follows by osmosis.

front: Why does oral rehydration solution contain glucose?
back: Sodium-glucose co-transport still works, so glucose and sodium are absorbed and water follows by osmosis.

front: Why is TB common among people living with HIV?
back: HIV destroys T-helper cells, so latent TB becomes active.
